chapterInfo.content:
2
Anyansafoɔ no
1 # Luka 2.1-7 Na wɔwoo Yesu Betlehem a ɛwɔ Yudea, Ɔhene Herode berɛ so no, hwɛ anyansafoɔ bi firi Apueeɛ baa Yerusalem 2#Num 24.17 bisaa sɛ: Ɛhe na Yudafoɔ hene a wɔawo no no wɔ? Na yɛahunu ne nsoromma wɔ Apueeɛ, na yɛreba abɛkoto no. 3Na Ɔhene Herode teeɛ no, ɔne Yerusalemfoɔ nyinaa akoma tui; 4na ɔhyiaa ɔman no mu asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ nyinaa bisaa wɔn faako a wɔbɛwo Kristo#2.4 KRISTO: Asekyerɛ ne Deɛ Wɔasra No. no. 5#Mika 5.1; Yoh 7.42 Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Betlehem a ɛwɔ Yudea; na saa ara na odiyifoɔ no atwerɛ sɛ:
6Na wo Betlehem, Yuda asase,
wonyɛ Yuda asafohene mu akumaa,
ɛfiri sɛ wo mu na ɔsafohene
a ɔbɛhwɛ me man Israel so no bɛfiri aba.
7Ɛnna Herode frɛɛ anyansafoɔ no kokoam, bisaa wɔn berɛ ko a nsoromma no firiiɛ no yie. 8Afei ɔsomaa wɔn Betlehem sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ abɔfra no yie; na sɛ monya hu no a, mommɛka nkyerɛ me, na me nso menkɔ nkɔkoto no bi. 9Na wɔtiee ɔhene asɛm no wieeɛ no, wɔsii mu kɔe; na hwɛ, nsoromma a wɔhunuu no Apueeɛ no dii wɔn anim ara de kɔsii sɛ ɛkɔgyinaa faako a abɔfra no wɔ no atifi. 10Na wɔhunuu nsoromma no no, wɔn ani gyee kɛseɛ pa ara. 11#Dwom 72.10; 72.15; Yes 60.6 Na wɔkɔɔ dan no mu no, wɔhunuu abɔfra no ne ne na Maria, na wɔkoto sɔree no; na wɔbuee wɔn fotoɔ mu yɛɛ no ayɛ, sika kɔkɔɔ ne ohwamfufuo ne korɔbɔ. 12Na wɔyi kyerɛɛ wɔn daeɛ mu sɛ wɔnnsane nnkɔ Herode hɔ bio no, wɔfaa ɔkwan foforɔ bi so sane kɔɔ wɔn kurom.
Wɔdwane kɔ Misraim
13Na wɔfiri hɔ kɔeɛ no, hwɛ, Awurade bɔfoɔ bi yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Yosef wɔ daeɛ mu sɛ: Sɔre fa abɔfra no ne ne na, na dwane kɔ Misraim, na kɔtena hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛka makyerɛ woɔ; na Herode rebɛhwehwɛ abɔfra no aku no. 14Na ɔsɔre faa abɔfra no ne ne na anadwo, na ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ Misraim, 15#Hos 11.1 na ɔwɔ hɔ ara kɔsii sɛ Herode wuiɛ; na deɛ Awurade nam odiyifoɔ no so kaeɛ no aba mu sɛ: Mafrɛ me ba afiri Misraim.
Wɔkunkum mmɔfra wɔ Betlehem
16Na Herode hunuu sɛ anyansafoɔ no agoro ne ho no, ne bo fuu pii; na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔkunkumm mmɔfra a wɔwɔ Betlehem ne n’ahyeɛ so a wɔadi mfeɛ mmienu ne wɔn a wɔnnya nniiɛ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ berɛ no a ɔbisabisaa anyansafoɔ no kyerɛ. 17#Yer 31.15 Ɛnna deɛ Odiyifoɔ Yeremia kaeɛ no baa mu sɛ:
18 # Gye 35.19 Wɔtee nne bi Rama,
esu ne awerɛhoɔ kɛseɛ;
Rahel resu ne mma,
na ɔmpɛ sɛ wɔkyekyere ne werɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni hɔ.
Wɔfiri Misraim sane ba
19Na Herode wuiɛ no, hwɛ, Awurade bɔfoɔ yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Yosef daeɛ mu wɔ Misraim 20#Eks 4.19 sɛ: Sɔre fa abɔfra no ne ne na, na kɔ Israel asase so; na wɔn a na wɔhwehwɛ abɔfra no akum no no awu. 21Na ɔsɔre faa abɔfra no ne ne na, na ɔbaa Israel asase so. 22Na ɔtee sɛ Arkelao di Yudea hene n’agya Herode ananmu no, ɔsuroo sɛ ɔbɛkɔ hɔ; na wɔyi kyerɛɛ no daeɛ mu no, ɔmane faa Galilea fam. 23#Luka 1.26; 2.39; Yoh 1.46; Yes 11.1; 53.2 Na ɔba bɛtenaa kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Nasaret mu, na deɛ odiyifoɔ no kaeɛ no aba mu sɛ: Wɔbɛfrɛ no Nasareni.

Na wɔwoo Yesu Betlehem a ɛwɔ Yudea, Ɔhene Herode berɛ so no, hwɛ anyansafoɔ bi firi Apueeɛ baa Yerusalem bisaa sɛ: Ɛhe na Yudafoɔ hene a wɔawo no no wɔ? Na yɛahunu ne nsoromma wɔ Apueeɛ, na yɛreba abɛkoto no. Na Ɔhene Herode teeɛ no, ɔne Yerusalemfoɔ nyinaa akoma tui; na ɔhyiaa ɔman no mu asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ nyinaa bisaa wɔn faako a wɔbɛwo Kristo no. wonyɛ Yuda asafohene mu akumaa,
ɛfiri sɛ wo mu na ɔsafohene
a ɔbɛhwɛ me man Israel so no bɛfiri aba.

Afei ɔsomaa wɔn Betlehem sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ abɔfra no yie; na sɛ monya hu no a, mommɛka nkyerɛ me, na me nso menkɔ nkɔkoto no bi. Na wɔtiee ɔhene asɛm no wieeɛ no, wɔsii mu kɔe; na hwɛ, nsoromma a wɔhunuu no Apueeɛ no dii wɔn anim ara de kɔsii sɛ ɛkɔgyinaa faako a abɔfra no wɔ no atifi. Na wɔhunuu nsoromma no no, wɔn ani gyee kɛseɛ pa ara. Na wɔkɔɔ dan no mu no, wɔhunuu abɔfra no ne ne na Maria, na wɔkoto sɔree no; na wɔbuee wɔn fotoɔ mu yɛɛ no ayɛ, sika kɔkɔɔ ne ohwamfufuo ne korɔbɔ. Na wɔfiri hɔ kɔeɛ no, hwɛ, Awurade bɔfoɔ bi yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Yosef wɔ daeɛ mu sɛ: Sɔre fa abɔfra no ne ne na, na dwane kɔ Misraim, na kɔtena hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛka makyerɛ woɔ; na Herode rebɛhwehwɛ abɔfra no aku no. Na ɔsɔre faa abɔfra no ne ne na anadwo, na ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ Misraim, na ɔwɔ hɔ ara kɔsii sɛ Herode wuiɛ; na deɛ Awurade nam odiyifoɔ no so kaeɛ no aba mu sɛ: Mafrɛ me ba afiri Misraim.

Na Herode hunuu sɛ anyansafoɔ no agoro ne ho no, ne bo fuu pii; na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔkunkumm mmɔfra a wɔwɔ Betlehem ne n’ahyeɛ so a wɔadi mfeɛ mmienu ne wɔn a wɔnnya nniiɛ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ berɛ no a ɔbisabisaa anyansafoɔ no kyerɛ. Ɛnna deɛ Odiyifoɔ Yeremia kaeɛ no baa mu sɛ:

esu ne awerɛhoɔ kɛseɛ;
Rahel resu ne mma,
na ɔmpɛ sɛ wɔkyekyere ne werɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni hɔ.


Na Herode wuiɛ no, hwɛ, Awurade bɔfoɔ yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Yosef daeɛ mu wɔ Misraim sɛ: Sɔre fa abɔfra no ne ne na, na kɔ Israel asase so; na wɔn a na wɔhwehwɛ abɔfra no akum no no awu. Na ɔsɔre faa abɔfra no ne ne na, na ɔbaa Israel asase so. Na ɔtee sɛ Arkelao di Yudea hene n’agya Herode ananmu no, ɔsuroo sɛ ɔbɛkɔ hɔ; na wɔyi kyerɛɛ no daeɛ mu no, ɔmane faa Galilea fam. Na ɔba bɛtenaa kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Nasaret mu, na deɛ odiyifoɔ no kaeɛ no aba mu sɛ: Wɔbɛfrɛ no Nasareni.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
